# Paravoxia — orchestration & token discipline

Fable weekly limits are the binding constraint; most spend is long-context
cache reads, not output. Every session in this repo follows these rules.

## Model tiering (frontmatter already set — don't override upward casually)

- **fable (inherit)**: `chapter-director`, `score-director`,
  `cinematography-director`, `story-alignment-judge`,
  `scene-cohesion-judge` — creative build and taste-critical judgment only.
- **opus**: `story-naive-reader`, `story-canon-auditor`, `story-verifier`,
  `scene-naive-viewer`, `cinematography-continuity-auditor`,
  `score-continuity-auditor`, `player-experience-auditor` — blind reading,
  auditing, and mechanical verification.
- Any ad-hoc Explore/general-purpose agent for searching, doc-reading, log
  triage, or probe-running: pass `model: "opus"` (or `"haiku"` for trivial
  greps). A mechanical subagent must never inherit fable.

## Main-session context hygiene

- Stay an orchestrator. Don't pull the design corpus (~65k tokens:
  `PARAVOXIA_PROGRESSION.md`, `PARAVOXIA_CH4_PLAN.md`, `main/STORY.md`) into
  the main context unless doing the creative work directly here — delegate
  reading to a subagent and keep only its conclusions.
- Verification (movie probes, screenshot strips, `npm run verify`) goes to
  `story-verifier`, not inline Bash loops. Run dev servers and long probes in
  the background; read back tails, never full logs.
- Guided-play changes require both the verifier's objective/marker/feedback
  lifecycle proof and a fresh read-only `player-experience-auditor` report.
  Neither role patches or substitutes for a creative director.
- After finishing a chapter or review, remind the owner to `/clear` before the
  next task; suggest `/compact` before starting a long build phase when
  context is already large.

## This machine runs concurrent sessions

Other agents and the owner work in this repo at the same time. Two incidents in
one session on 2026-09-04:

- A parallel refactor of `main/src/utils/fauna*.ts` landed mid-`verify` and made
  it fail on files the running session had never touched. **Before treating a
  gate failure as yours, check `ls -l` timestamps against your last edit.** Do
  not "fix" a module someone is actively splitting — you will collide with work
  whose destination only they know.
- A probe pointed at `127.0.0.1:5199` measured a DIFFERENT PROJECT after that
  port was taken over. It returned 200 and rendered a real app, so nothing
  looked wrong. **Probes must verify identity, not liveness** — check for
  `<title>Paravoxia</title>` before trusting a measurement. `npm run
  verify:visual` picks a free port and does this check; copy that pattern.

`npm run dev` fails here with `ENOSPC: System limit for number of file watchers
reached` (the `captures/` tree is enormous). Use `npm run build` plus
`npx vite preview`.

Two more harness traps, both hit on 2026-09-04:

- **A background shell that waits with `until ! pgrep -f "<name>"` waits forever**,
  because the pattern matches the waiting shell's own command line. Use the
  bracket trick — `pgrep -f "[n]ame"` — or run dependent steps sequentially in
  one shell instead of polling.
- **Probes must own their server's lifetime.** Nine orphaned `vite preview`
  processes were left behind by probes that crashed. `tools/lib/previewServer.mjs`
  now kills the child on exit/signal; use it rather than spawning a preview by
  hand. Its `assertHardwareGl` check is also mandatory: without `--use-gl=angle`
  headless Chromium here silently used SwiftShader and a boot profile showed a
  20-second stall that the real GPU never produces.
- **Probe switches** (players never set these): `?worldprep=sync` forces the legacy
  synchronous world generation; `?beatregistry=off` serves the legacy story tables
  instead of beat contracts. Both exist so a baseline and a candidate come from ONE build.
- **Edit-then-measure ordering.** A build started 27 seconds after a source edit
  contains that edit. Capture a baseline BEFORE changing the code path it
  measures, or use the same-build A/B switches (`?worldprep=sync`,
  `?beatregistry=off`) so baseline and candidate come from one build.

## Creative triad

For any new scene, awakening, substantial cutscene recut, or audiovisual
polish pass, invoke the `creative-triad` skill. The Chapter, Score, and
Cinematography directors are peers. They communicate through the run's scene
contract and structured director notes; they do not race edits in shared
timeline files or approve their own implementation.

Chapter, Score, and Cinematography are exactly the three peer creative
directors. Auditors, verifiers, judges, and integration engineers provide
checks, evidence, and repair routing; they never become a fourth creative lane.

Durable contracts live in:

- `PARAVOXIA_CREATIVE_COUNCIL.md`
- `main/CINEMATOGRAPHY.md`
- `main/src/story/ux/README.md` (the executable player-guidance context
  contract for objective, marker, HUD, and feedback lifecycles)
- `docs/architecture/workflow-orchestration/examples/paravoxia-creative-triad.workflow.json`
- `.codex/production-runs/_template/`

## Story scope

Post-arrival story work is **authorized**. The owner lifted the post-arrival
gate on 2026-07-28 (recorded at the top of `PARAVOXIA_DEMO_FOUNDATION_PLAN.md`):
story beyond `ch9-hearth` may be designed, built, and registered, including the
space-station chapter. Do not refuse or defer this work on the basis of an
older freeze — earlier revisions of this file carried one, and it expired.

What still applies:

- **Creative-Triad and registry gates are the remaining barrier** between a new
  chapter and the runtime. Route the work through them; do not route around.
- **Sequencing is owner-directed: do not rush to the station.** Making the
  existing story enjoyable comes first, and the need to leave must emerge from
  play rather than from a new content hook.
- **The demo's release surface is unchanged** — it still stops at
  `ch4-arrival`, and publishing remains a separate decision. Building past it
  is allowed; shipping it in the demo is not implied.
- **Shipped copy and audio remain protected baselines.** Changing a protected
  audio/runtime path is still a contracted change, not an incidental one.
- **"Anchorage" is retired as a name.** The location is the **space station**.

# After the hearth

Status: routed to the story council before scene production.

The Chapter Director recommends Common Ground, a bounded continuation involving W-7744 returning to the origin world. His reason for returning and the extent of cooperation are explicitly reserved canon decisions. The complete candidate is being prepared in `.codex/story-runs/2026-09-06-common-ground/`.

No runtime or current canon changes have been made. Resume scene production here only after the exact story candidate has its three director signatures and actual owner canon decision. Existing story building authorization remains valid; no stale post-arrival freeze is being applied.
=== LOCK ===
# Production lock — After the hearth

Status: locked for preproduction; next playable chapter commissioned.

The owner requested on 2026-09-05: “okay, well lets continue the story, be creative, be imaginitaive, keep it aligned with the plot thusfar, but take the game to the next level.” This authorizes developing and implementing a bounded continuation of the existing plot. The 2026-07-28 gate lift authorizes post-arrival story and supersedes stale freezes in older council/skill prose. Publishing remains separate.

Initial boundary: run-local artifacts and non-mutating reconnaissance/capture only, while Stage 1 determines exact content, runtime paths and real owner-only decisions. This temporary scope is not a claim that the owner has withheld permission to continue the story. Runtime changes begin after the specific scene contract and required gates. Do not manufacture owner decisions for routine design or implementation choices. Never resolve protected ontology, W-7744 motive, A5 timing, or late awakening gates by inference.

Entry: the R12 station visit has issued one bonded cell, the player has returned to Tidegarden, and installation has consumed it and recorded the second hearth restored. The formal chapter registry currently ends at Chapter 10; ch11/ch12 milestone namespaces reserve chronology but are not registered beats. Preserve this distinction.

Allowed repository writes: this run directory only. Scratch files and capture/build output may use /tmp. Protect every existing source, canon and configuration file in this phase. Existing dirty work is separately owned; initial status and source hashes are recorded before any task mutation. Never reset, clean, stash, rewrite or commit that work.

Mode/profile: chapter / paravoxia-creative-chapter@v1, deep; at most 4 patch loops and 3 independent review passes. Story, Score and Cinematography are peer directors. Probe work follows the story-verifier role, with headed hardware evidence, explicit adapter identity, one heavy GPU job, and no competing servers. A baseline may be reconstructed diagnostically but must say so and cannot claim continuous completion.

Stage 1 deliverables: grounded story intent, source and canon map, current visual/UX baseline, scoped runtime integration inventory, and a decision brief containing only unresolved owner-only decisions. Later Stage 2 must not run with pending brief items. No signatures or owner decisions may be fabricated.

Release candidate: false. Publish allowed: false. Public demo ceiling stays ch4-arrival.
=== ASSEMBLY NOTES ===
# Scene-contract assembly notes

Producer mechanical preparation, 2026-09-06. `scene-contract.assembly.json` is a
DRAFT (`status: draft`, `contractVersion: scene-v1`) awaiting lane review. It
claims no approval, no runtime authority, no signature and no measured result.
The active `scene-contract.json`, the lock, signatures, source, schema,
validator and director-owned treatments were not modified.

## Validation performed

Ajv is not installed in this repo, so the file was checked with a local
draft-subset validator against the checked-in scene-contract schema, plus a
mirror of the gate's structural reference, guidance-lifecycle, placeholder and
band-prose checks. Result: 0 schema errors; 1 mirrored gate failure (below).
Every `evidenceRefs`, authority, palette, cut and probe path resolves today.

## Open, unbound and conflicting fields

1. `ux.contract-work-order` fails for `station:return:tidegarden`: its exact
   shipped last line, "DELIVER THE BONDED CELL TO THE SECOND HEARTH.", contains
   no verb in the gate's `travel` lexicon. Copy was preserved rather than
   rewritten. Lane decision required.
2. `ch13:return:launch` is bound as `kind: wait`, `requiresMarker: false`,
   `targetMode: none` with a nominated `targetContract`, because "[Space]" is
   not a single-letter bracket token. Confirm or re-map.
3. `performance` draw-call, shader and GPU-memory budgets are deliberately
   unbound fail-safe zeros; delta budgets are Cinematography and measurement
   work.
4. `mutationBoundary: bounded-runtime` is proposed and does not yet match the
   planning-only lock; `canonicalPreviewUrl` is provisional localhost, not a
   running preview.
5. `evidence.headedTaste.required` is set true from the intent's hardware and
   listening obligations; confirm.
6. Geometry is recorded only as producer-nominated range 12 from
   `geometry-instrument.json`; the qualification is still running and no pass is
   claimed.

Contingent holds and resumes use equivalent-order anchor slots so no route is
implied to fail.

# Decision brief — Common Ground production intent

**FINAL Stage 1 packet ready for scene-contract synthesis; measured bindings complete.** Range 12, the connected instrument, actual 36/16-unit survey routes, 18-unit common passage, separate worker H position and uncredited positioning legs are bound. All eight authority items are decided. This packet is not a scene signature or runtime authorization; required council judgment and the exact scene contract still govern opening runtime.

The direct instruction “yes continue, and please auto approve everything” is recorded in [owner-standing-authority.json](../../story-runs/2026-09-06-common-ground/owner-standing-authority.json). It delegates in-scope design, the compact apparatus and the necessary future integration subset. Council-v2 has exact three-lane documentation signatures and separate delegated adoption in [owner-story-decision.json](../../story-runs/2026-09-06-common-ground/owner-story-decision.json), dated 2026-09-06T06:30:50.841372+00:00. The signed candidate/register remain immutable; this owned scene packet binds their qualified realization.

The legacy schema requires `decidedBy: owner` and `pending | decided`. Every item is **decided** under standing delegation. “Owner” names the authority principal; it does not claim personal human review of later files, hashes or media. There is no pending owner question, range choice, head connection or near-body placement.

| Item | Kind | Bound decision | Remaining production work |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CG-S1-creative | creative | Four ch13 beats, genuine restoration/movie bridge, chosen Origin return, limited local W recurrence, necessary reciprocal comparison, quiet tracing and protected later reveals | Required council judgment and exact scene contract |
| CG-S1-physical-evidence | creative | Range 12; exact staged apparatus/poses/routes; passed connected cap and distinct H reference; unchanged trace thresholds | Live runtime and rendered verification after implementation |
| CG-S1-boundary-state | boundary | Chapter-local route/actor/state owners; WorldSave-only persistence; separate survey, recording, positioning and proof facts | Smallest necessary signed subset; no positioning-leg proof credit |
| CG-S1-boundary-world-ux | boundary | Exact objective/marker/F lifecycles; one truthful S start action; launch interact/control-only with explicit no-target contract | Real readiness, clearance, input and body/core/apparatus proof |
| CG-S1-boundary-bridge | boundary | Real station departure, undock/fly, Tidegarden landing/install, home invitation and ch13 | Continuous movie proof without reseeding or timeout success |
| CG-S1-boundary-registry | boundary | Formal ch13; preserved ch11/ch12 receipts; explicit external transition and strict ordinary adjacency | Exact generated views, schema/state producers and evidence |
| CG-S1-boundary-score-av | boundary | No reference/housing/realization cue; earned completion only changes spacing; immediate handback, at most five-second live texture then existing 4.5-second release | Cancellation/no-replay and combined listening proof |
| CG-S1-release | release | Local development/verification; public ceiling ch4-arrival; no publication/redeploy | No release action in this commission |

The [decision-brief.json](decision-brief.json) retains the 63 future path/seam entries from the integration survey, [implementation-interface-plan.md](../../story-runs/2026-09-06-common-ground/implementation-interface-plan.md) and assembly notes. New interfaces remain identified as proposed. Open only the necessary exact signed subset, recheck current hashes/timestamps and use one shared-file integrator. Preserve unrelated dirty work, live untracked refactors, initial status/hash artifacts and existing signatures. Rails belong in `main/src/story/autopilot/`; `GlobalSave` stays unchanged. Dormant home entry is the actual restored Tidegarden core. The new scene registers only ch13-home, ch13-return, ch13-survey and ch13-common. Existing station return/install objectives remain shipped-baseline and prior station-continuation-contract continuity evidence; no invented restored-hearth formal beat. A fresh real install receipt may reactivate ch13-home and emit its one authored hearth acknowledgement there; restored saves use steady entry, without replaying or delaying the transaction.

Final measurement: [staged-geometry-qualification.json](../../story-runs/2026-09-06-common-ground/staged-geometry-qualification.json), SHA-256 `7cc0d63d843df60462a2fd55ba928bfd5656c20b4d20c31a581fec559532b7ff`, **PASS**. Origin world -1,-1, R=(-34,51.05,20), yaw 90 degrees; S=(-26,51.05,12), E=(-42,51.05,12), H=(-40,51.05,12), C=(-48,51.05,12), final Terra T=(-44,51.05,12), initial inspection/intermediate example W=(-34,51.05,10).

Short survey: 16 units/17 samples, 14 backing-unsupported units. Long survey: 36 units/61 samples, fully supported, +20 units and 2.25-times length. Common E→C: actual 18-unit detour/31 samples, all 73 dense points supported from H, max distance 10.01 within range 12 and two-unit body clearance. A real eight-unit contiguous portion requires his reference. Worker physically moves E→H before her comparison and H→E after her explicit T offer; both two-unit legs are valid and earn no comparison/test credit. His full final E→C test stays supported from T with two-unit clearance. Use these paths, never the six-unit endpoint shortcut.

The cap connects the stand to the fixed socket with zero gap. Six contact tests pass: general symmetric endpoint-only contact is harmless only when the open segment stays outside; interior crossing and face tangency block. All housing/trunk solids participate; walking/body collision remains inclusive. No exemption, invisible barrier, coordinate-only witness quota or worldgen change is authorized. The earlier water search did establish two banks and a detour; it failed reference separation, not topology. Its failure remains preserved rather than back-credited as a pass.

Offering beside the worker opens the survey without sampling. `ch13:survey:start` marks S as **Survey start · begin a route**, with **Walk to the survey start. [F] Begin recording your route.** Actual F at S starts the trace, then one quiet draw objective targets E. After an actual span offer the worker approaches S on grounded clear terrain without proof credit, vacating W before optional witness use. Launch retains **Kestrel controls · lift** and **Hold [Space] to ignite and lift.** It is `interact`, `targetMode: none`, `requiresMarker: false`, `maxVisibleTargets: 0`, after actual boarding; no zero-coordinate marker or wait classification.

The 11-frame baseline still reports no W-7744 body or built Tidegarden core. Source geometry now qualifies the proposed layout and contact/body relations. Actual rendered staging, live edited-terrain response, input hysteresis, night/tier readability, hardware and audiovisual acceptance follow signed implementation; none is claimed here. Keep separate WorldSave invitation/recording state, survey class, tested prefix, reciprocal proof, final offer and actor positioning phase. Stored proof never becomes unlimited sensing.

**Cinema:** keep feet, housing/socket relation, trace break and both reference exchanges legible within the existing embodied view. All-day interaction is the target; night/lowest-tier contact and apparatus/actor blocking are postimplementation acceptance work, not invented current evidence or an extra precontract render gate.

Transient established-witness vacancy or body-clearance suspension/resume retains the current texture. CG-05 reciprocal crossing and CG-06 initiation retain restrained demonstration. Stillness is chosen inspection or a safe specific hold, without a rescue deadline or endangered hearth. Persistent evidence remains understandable after a missed caption or missing musical note. Protected mysteries are deliberately silent.

## Routed decisions

`decision-brief.json/md` records the delegated creative/apparatus decisions, exact future file/symbol subset and release boundary. All eight owner items are decided. Range 12, the complete staged placement including H and the connected head, and the exact proof hash above are bound. Council-v2 has exact documentation signatures and separate delegated adoption; independent council judgment and the separately signed scene contract still govern opening runtime. No council artifact/signature, initial hash/status or planning lock is changed by this update. Later media, hardware and interaction acceptance remain postimplementation obligations.

## Questions and non-goals

No owner item, range choice, head connection or near-body placement remains pending in this intent. The accepted measured scene bindings are ready for synthesis. This is not a claim that the new runtime, render, input or hardware behavior has passed.

No new plot exploration/canon, A5 warp/Light, A6 alliance/authorship, later Lens/Frame, identity reveal, station surveillance, new cell fault, fauna consequence, marker puzzle, worldgen edit, audio-engine rewrite, mass copy cleanup or publishing. Protect the working home, receipts, old actor departure and unrelated dirty work.

## Chapter Director disposition

**FINAL Stage 1 intent ready for scene-contract synthesis.** The selected range, actual survey/common paths, connected apparatus, distinct H reference, uncredited positioning legs and proof hash are bound; incoming Score/Cinema responses are in `chapter-reconciliation.jsonl`. No new story direction or user permission is needed. This intent is not a scene signature or runtime authorization. Required council judgment and scene-contract gates remain. After signed implementation, prove both route classes and saved repeatability, actual reciprocal need, physical/reference retry, real core/body/apparatus blocking, authentic station-home-ch13 continuity, three cold no-rescue movies, complete UX/input/reset/tier checks, hardware frames, combined listening and independent reviews. No such acceptance is claimed now.

| `hearth:return:install-cell` | SECOND HEARTH · INSTALL BONDED CELL | DELIVER THE BONDED CELL TO THE SECOND HEARTH. [F] INSTALL THE SEALED CELL. | Consume one and commit existing ch12 receipts; notify home entry without delaying or replaying the transaction |

New ch13 guidance:

| Objective ID | Exact display / marker label | Standing work order | Real transition |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `ch13:home:review` | Second hearth · unfinished audit | Return to the working hearth. [F] Review the stored audit fault. | Actual core review → choose-return |
| `ch13:home:choose-return` | Second hearth · choose the return | [F] Choose to revisit the Origin audit site. You can leave this open. | Intent commit → actual hatch/course substep |
| `ch13:return:board` | Kestrel hatch · board | Follow the hatch marker. [F] Board the Kestrel. | Actual boarded state → launch/current flight substep |
| `ch13:return:launch` | Kestrel controls · lift | Hold [Space] to ignite and lift. | Actual boarded ship accepts held control; actual flight → Origin course |
| `ch13:return:origin` | Origin · audit site | Fly to Origin. Follow the audit-site approach and land. | Actual world/grounded flight facts → disembark/approach |
| `ch13:survey:offer` | W-7744 · offer a route | Approach W-7744. [F] Offer to demonstrate a route. | Open actor/world-scoped survey → start; do not record beside the actor |
| `ch13:survey:start` | Survey start · begin a route | Walk to the survey start. [F] Begin recording your route. | Actual grounded F at S begins the first sample and replaces start with quiet draw guidance to E |
| `ch13:survey:draw` | Survey end · demonstrate a route | Walk your route to the survey end. [F] Offer the recorded span. | Grounded samples form proposal, not accepted proof |
| `ch13:survey:offer-span` | Trace end · offer this span | [F] Offer the walked span for W-7744 to test. | Explicit valid span offer → actual worker approach to S; arrival enables its test, approach earns no proof |
| `ch13:survey:test` | W-7744 · test in progress | W-7744 is testing the offered route. Follow his progress, or return to the last tested point to revise. | Actual worker samples → hold/next span/reciprocal |
| `ch13:survey:revise` | Last tested point · revise route | Return to the last tested point. [F] Reopen the untested span and walk a new route. | Reopen unverified tail → draw; include actual refusal reason |
| `ch13:survey:witness` | Witness point · hold this end | Stand at the marked reference. [F] Offer this end, then remain here while W-7744 tests the span. Looking around is free. | Offer + occupancy + valid geometry maintains test |
| `ch13:survey:witness-return` | Witness point · resume the test | Return to the marked reference to resume the test. To change the route, return to the last tested point. | Reenter inner cylinder and revalidate; no second F |
| `ch13:common:reciprocal` | Far reference · check my route | W-7744 is holding the reference. Walk the traced span to check your route from this end. | Ready only after physical E→H; actual full 18-unit passage E→C under H records Terra's comparison |
| `ch13:common:offer-final-reference` | Far reference · offer this end | Stand at the far reference, clear of the tested span. [F] Offer this end. | Explicit valid offer replaces guidance; does not commit his test |
| `ch13:common:release` | Far reference · keep this end | Remain at the far reference while W-7744 tests the span. Looking around is free. | Explicit T offer and current reference permit H→E positioning without proof, then full E→C test; actual arrival plus comparison commits once |
| `ch13:common:reference-return` | Far reference · resume the test | Return to the far reference, clear of the tested span, to resume the test. Looking around is free. | Reentry and actual revalidation resume without another F; retained proof alone cannot move him |

`ch13:return:launch` is `kind: interact`, `targetMode: none`, `requiresMarker: false`, with `targetContract.maxVisibleTargets: 0`. Its owner/selection are the existing boarded Kestrel controls and chapter launch state; readiness requires actual boarding/control ownership, completion requires actual ignition/lift into flight, and evidence records those control facts plus zero published targets. Keep the exact Space-hold copy and Kestrel-controls label. No invented world handle, zero-coordinate marker or wait classification is allowed.

The one-time survey-start marker targets S, never E or the inspection actor. Start F uses existing arbitration and ground/reach validation; no sample is recorded until that actual beginning. Quiet drawing then has no further point/turn prompts. Before actor arrival at S, report approach/preparation through actual readiness state instead of claiming testing; approach movement never grows the tested prefix.

Do not publish the reciprocal work order's “is holding” assertion before H is physically reached; readiness/preparation must report the actual positioning state. `anc.cg.reciprocal-reference` means the real maintained H relation. `anc.cg.independent-test` begins the full E→C test after H→E positioning, not at the final F offer or during that positioning leg. Both legs remain ordinary grounded actor movement with no new player task or proof credit.

Draw targets the survey destination; offer-span replaces it with the actual trace end when that is the actionable target. Never change a marker behind an unchanged objective. Continuous walking retains one quiet work order: no sample/turn prompt, chime or congratulatory microstep. Witness vacancy publishes the appropriate survey or final reference-return objective; missing footing publishes revision because occupancy cannot repair ground. Alternative nearby actions use the same resolver without competing required markers.

Each entry has one semantic acknowledgement, actual trace growth shows progress without per-sample chimes, invalid input has a literal reason, and commits clear/replace old guidance within the existing UX frame contract. Exact frame bands remain scene-contract evidence work. Restore is silent. Missing/unmounted targets expose preparation or world-return state rather than a zero-coordinate marker. The prior live install retires its existing objective at the real transaction. Its fresh receipt can trigger one authored live hearth acknowledgement within ch13-home at the actual core; retire that transient before the invitation. This is a presentation boundary, never a delayed transaction or audio/listening prerequisite. Restored saves get steady state only. No required action depends solely on a transient caption.

## World-reference, persistence and reset constraints

The longer survey route uses the fixed reference throughout; the shorter needs one occupied intermediate reference through the actual housing shadow. Both are complete equal outcomes, with no moral or musical ranking and no forced failed first attempt. Test actual grounded samples in the offered corridor under current worker dry/top-face/slope/clearance rules. Replanning cannot cut across the demonstrated argument. Save the chosen survey class separately from the common reciprocal comparison.

Witness validity uses same-world identity, grounding, explicitly offered position, selected socket-to-socket range, occupancy hysteresis, current body clearance and a clear solid segment. Inner/reentry radius: 1.25 units, vertical tolerance 0.6; release radius: 1.75, tolerance 0.9. Fixed apparatus, intermediate witness and both reciprocal roles use this same world-reference rule. No camera quaternion, reticle, screen visibility, gaze duration, music phase or optional foliage is an input. A new untested endpoint cannot silently become a fixed reference and remove dependence. Looking away changes nothing.

Leaving the release cylinder holds before the next unsupported sample, retains proof and keeps the offer resumable. Returning to the inner cylinder resumes after geometry revalidation, without another F. Report `REFERENCE OCCLUDED · SURVEY HOUSING` only for actual backing occlusion; distinguish `REFERENCE OUT OF RANGE`, other actual solid occlusion, unsafe footing and temporary witness vacancy. Occlusion permits a valid reference or redrawn tail; occupancy never repairs unsafe ground. W-7744's actual H reference is his authored contribution, not a player “cooperate” command. After Terra's proof, her explicit F offer supplies conditions for his independent choice, not a command to move. Neither saved evidence nor elapsed time exempts his final test from live range, sight, occupancy and clearance.

One typed/versioned actor/world snapshot stores two route slots maximum (`accepted`, `working`), 128 samples and 120 walked units each, one intermediate witness, safe actor pose, tested prefix, survey class, reciprocal proof, final reference offer, physical positioning phase and explicit hold/reset state. The interface plan's illustrative type must carry these distinct earned facts; `reciprocal.held` alone cannot stand for Terra's passage or final offer. Persist accepted survey invitation, awaiting-start/recording state and actor positioning phase/pose separately: approach to S and E→H/H→E never advance either proof counter. Samples normally require one unit; meaningful corners may be closer, never below 0.25. At capacity stop honestly without decimation, then offer or revise. Unlimited cost-free revision replaces the unverified suffix. Explicit proposal reset at the start while the worker is stationary clears only uncommitted work. Optional repeat uses/replaces the alternate slot and retains the accepted primary.

Pause, world departure, quit and Continue preserve the snapshot and clear local presentation ownership. Revalidate edits, malformed/legacy data and wrong identity; never reset user construction or restore pristine terrain during ordinary entry. Checkpoints record committed acts; observations stay non-gating; session events are not a save. Dedicated restart/dev entry uses the approved physical story boundary. New resume clauses precede ch10's done return.

Completion retains one bounded tester and local survey on Origin; later visits restore a supported safe pose and optional repeat without required chapter guidance. No Tidegarden actor, passenger, A4 pack replay or farewell disappearance. Non-story sandbox state remains unchanged.

Implementation ownership is bounded: `commonGroundState.ts` owns typed reducers and hydration; `WorldSave.commonGround` plus `saveWorld`, `restoreCommonGroundForWorld` and `clearCommonGroundForWorld` own world-scoped persistence, with no `GlobalSave` change. `commonGroundActor.ts` is the only ch13 pose writer for existing `AuditWorker`; `CommonGroundWorld.tsx` owns the visible field instrument, trace and registered world handles; `commonGroundRoute.ts` owns the injected solid/range/ground predicate. Reuse the existing navigation functions, interaction resolver and marker authority unchanged outside those declared seams.

## Constraints for peer directors

**Cinema:** keep feet, housing/socket relation, trace break and both reference exchanges legible within the existing embodied view. Proposed/tested trace differs by stable shape/value, remains depth-tested and depicts walked ground only. Retain palettes, alive stage, 75-degree player-view lineage and vehicle rig. No forced look, view switch, friendly visor, new light or postprocessing upgrade. The backing remains equally real at every tier. Prewarm bounded resources and preserve light cardinality. All-day interaction is the target; night/lowest-tier contact and apparatus/actor blocking are postimplementation acceptance work, not invented current evidence or an extra precontract render gate.

**Score:** settled home/archive sound with no transmission cue; release the home quotation at `anc.cg.return-chosen`, and begin audit square only at the actual mounted/performed reinspection at `anc.cg.repeated-measure`, never camera visibility. Only a real unsupported offered span enters `anc.cg.specific-hold` once, with the literal physical reason; failed-input repetition does not restart it. Transient established-witness vacancy or body-clearance suspension/resume retains the current texture. CG-05 reciprocal crossing and CG-06 initiation retain restrained demonstration. Only CG-07 completion permits changed spacing. CG-08 frees controls/progression and retires mandatory guidance immediately. One live-only final texture may last at most five seconds, then the existing 4.5-second release; no further coda. Cancel on new story/optional survey, actor/world change, reset, exit, pause, visibility loss, mute or unavailable audio. Never defer, hydrate or replay it. This requires future chapter-local integration through existing score authority; it is not assumed shipped. No new graph, hit bundle, route ranking, guaranteed attack or listening gate.

Stillness is chosen inspection or a safe specific hold, without a rescue deadline or endangered hearth. Persistent evidence remains understandable after a missed caption or missing musical note. Protected mysteries are deliberately silent.

## Routed decisions

`decision-brief.json/md` records the delegated creative/apparatus decisions, exact future file/symbol subset and release boundary. All eight owner items are decided. Range 12, the complete staged placement including H and the connected head, and the exact proof hash above are bound. Council-v2 has exact documentation signatures and separate delegated adoption; independent council judgment and the separately signed scene contract still govern opening runtime. No council artifact/signature, initial hash/status or planning lock is changed by this update. Later media, hardware and interaction acceptance remain postimplementation obligations.

## Questions and non-goals

No owner item, range choice, head connection or near-body placement remains pending in this intent. The accepted measured scene bindings are ready for synthesis. This is not a claim that the new runtime, render, input or hardware behavior has passed.

No new plot exploration/canon, A5 warp/Light, A6 alliance/authorship, later Lens/Frame, identity reveal, station surveillance, new cell fault, fauna consequence, marker puzzle, worldgen edit, audio-engine rewrite, mass copy cleanup or publishing. Protect the working home, receipts, old actor departure and unrelated dirty work.

## Chapter Director disposition

**FINAL Stage 1 intent ready for scene-contract synthesis.** The selected range, actual survey/common paths, connected apparatus, distinct H reference, uncredited positioning legs and proof hash are bound; incoming Score/Cinema responses are in `chapter-reconciliation.jsonl`. No new story direction or user permission is needed. This intent is not a scene signature or runtime authorization. Required council judgment and scene-contract gates remain. After signed implementation, prove both route classes and saved repeatability, actual reciprocal need, physical/reference retry, real core/body/apparatus blocking, authentic station-home-ch13 continuity, three cold no-rescue movies, complete UX/input/reset/tier checks, hardware frames, combined listening and independent reviews. No such acceptance is claimed now.

 ],

}

# Scene-contract final-candidate assembly notes

Mechanical producer assembly, 2026-09-06. `scene-contract.final-candidate.json`
(SHA-256 `60be671dc0bff6ece79660e1163de19126515c32b547faf8f19714e737271571`) is a
DRAFT. It claims no approval, no signature, no runtime authority and no measured
result. It was built from the stale `scene-contract.assembly.json` template by
`assemble-final-candidate.mjs` (run-local helper, writes only the candidate).

Nothing outside this run's `scene-contract.final-candidate.json`,
`assembly-final-notes.md` and `assemble-final-candidate.mjs` was written. The
production lock, decision brief, treatments, lane files, reconciliations,
signatures, source, schema and gate tooling are untouched.

Final authority used: `story-intent.md`, `scene-score-lane.json`,
`scene-cinema-lane.json` and the three recipient reconciliations, with the
council-v2 approved documents and the qualification packet bound by hash.

## Counts

| Section | Count |
| --- | --- |
| Formal beats | 4 (`ch13-home`, `ch13-return`, `ch13-survey`, `ch13-common`) |

| Story events | 27 (1:1 with anchors) |
| Agency windows | 5 |
| Guidance objectives | 17 new ch13 pairs |
| Prior-continuity objective pairs | 2, retained as baseline/continuity evidence only, not contract guidance |
| Shots | 9 (accepted cinema ledger) |
| Score cues | 6 (accepted mood bindings) |
| Acceptance criteria | 28 |
| Captures / mechanical checks | 9 / 15 |

## What was integrated

**Scope.** Only the four formal beats exist. `ev/anc.cg.station-departed` and
`ev/anc.cg.tidegarden-returned`, the `aw.cg.station-return` agency window and
the two old objective pairs (`station:return:tidegarden`,
`hearth:return:install-cell`) were removed from the contract. They remain
shipped UX baseline and prior station-continuation-contract continuity, cited in
`scope.shippedReferenceRefs` and required in full as adjacent-continuity proof
(actual station UI departure, undock, flight, Tidegarden landing, one-cell
install) by `cap.cg.continuity-strip` and the acceptance criteria. No
`second-hearth-restored` StoryBeat exists anywhere in the document.
`anc.cg.cell-installed` now belongs to `ch13-home`: a fresh real install receipt
reactivates ch13-home and may fire one live CG-B0 acknowledgement at the
boundary when a home score host is available; a hydrated entry is steady and
silent; the transaction is never delayed or replayed.

**Rename.** The exact map was applied atomically in one pass over every
anchor/event reference in the document (`route-offered → demonstration-opened`
and `span-offered → route-offered` together, so no collision), plus
`witness-required → specific-hold`, `tail-redrawn → route-revised`,
`witness-resumed → test-resumed`, `his-test-arrival → complete`,
`open-ground → handback`. `anc.cg.return-chosen` and `anc.cg.repeated-measure`
are retained as baseline anchors. `aw.cg.open-ground` was renamed

`anc.cg.survey-started` (actual grounded F at S),
`anc.cg.reciprocal-reference` (W actually reaches and maintains H before Terra
starts) and `anc.cg.independent-test` (begins only after the actual H→E leg and
a valid far Terra reference, at the start of the full E→C traversal). A
verification pass fails the build if any retired identifier survives.

**Guidance.** All 17 pairs carry the exact intent copy. `ch13:return:launch` is
`interact` / `targetMode: none` / `requiresMarker: false` /
`targetContract.maxVisibleTargets: 0` with the exact `Hold [Space] to ignite and
lift.` line; it is explicitly not reclassified as a wait. The initial F beside
the inspecting worker only opens the survey; `ch13:survey:start` publishes the
exact pair `Survey start · begin a route` / `Walk to the survey start. [F] Begin
recording your route.` targeting S only, and the actual grounded F at S starts
the quiet trace. The worker's physical W→S approach is contracted as uncredited.
`ch13:common:release` is `wait` because the required act genuinely is remaining
in place; that is stated in its acceptance criterion.

**Cinematography.** The six placeholder shots were replaced by the accepted
nine-shot ledger (`shot.cg.home`, `choose`, `return`, `draw`, `hold`, `witness`,
`other-end`, `his-test`, `complete`), adapted mechanically to the schema shot
shape. Free 75-degree on-foot FOV, fixed lights (zero new lights, zero
cardinality transitions), unchanged grade, no post effects, no forced camera.
Every anchor relates to at least one shot and at least one score cue; no-op
anchors carry explicit `unchanged` / `retained` relations rather than an
invented cue or move.

**Geometry.** Bound from the final qualified packet: range 12, R (-34, 51.05,
20) yaw 90, cap-to-socket zero gap with the general symmetric endpoint-contact
rule and six passing contact tests, 36 vs 16 unit surveys, 18-unit common
passage, H (-40, 51.05, 12) distinct from E (-42, 51.05, 12), the two uncredited
2-unit E→H and H→E legs, T (-44, 51.05, 12), W (-34, 51.05, 10). Hashes bound in
`production.authorityRefs` and `chk.cg.geometry-qualification`: staged
`7cc0d63d…b7ff` (PASS), head `e64ce08e…4b4d1` (PASS). The stale "no geometry is
qualified", the 32-unit long route and the release-cylinder-overlap wording were
removed.

**Score.** Exactly six cues bound to the accepted mood variants
(`restored-home`, `unreconciled`, `demonstrating`, `refused-hold`, `revised`,
`independent-action-settled`). No separate mood per UX event. Quiet refusal
enters once; repeated reference loss and temporary suspension retain the current
texture. The final texture is live-only, at most 5 s, then the existing 4.5 s
release; handback is immediate and independent of the tail; no replay, defer,
hydrate or audio predicate.

**Performance.** Accepted DELTA budgets: +8 draw calls, +6 materials, +6 setup
shader programs, +2 MiB (2097152 bytes), 512 pooled glyph instances across two
128-point buffers, zero new programs and zero first-use resources in the ±2 s
critical windows around every critical verb anchor and the handback, fixed light
cardinality, hardware FPS non-regression. 60 / 30 / 33.4 are recorded as
advisory. `measurementPlan` states the DELTA semantics explicitly and records
that no measured frame or resource pass is claimed.

**Production.** `status: draft`, `canonicalPreviewUrl: null`, `frozenAt: null`.
`allowedPaths` / `protectedPaths` were carried through unchanged for root to
replace from the updated brief and lock. The stale non-negotiable "the formal
runtime ceiling … unchanged by this contract" was replaced with the correct
authorized distinction: the public demo release surface remains `ch4-arrival`
and no publication is authorized, while the formal runtime chapter ceiling is
separately authorized to advance to `ch13-common` once these four beats are
registered under the signed contract and the registry gate. Declared future
evidence is retained; no approved-live claim was added.

## Validation performed

Read-only, no shared gate artifact was written or mutated.

1. Reference integrity inside the helper: every anchor/event/window/objective/
   shot/cue/reset/palette/variant/critical-anchor/capture reference resolves;
   every anchor has at least one shot and one score relation; retired
   identifiers are absent. **0 errors.**
2. Full structural validation against the checked-in
   `paravoxia-scene-contract.schema.json` with `$ref` resolution, closed-object
   `additionalProperties: false`, enums, consts and patterns, plus mirrors of
   the gate's `BAND_PROSE` and `PLACEHOLDER_PATTERN` scans. **0 errors, no
   invalid extra property, no band-shaped criterion, no placeholder.**
3. The gate's own `tools/lib/guidanceTargets.mjs` imported read-only and run
   over all 17 objectives, plus a mirror of `actionableWorkOrder`. **1 failure,
   below.** All 17 final work-order lines satisfy the current lexicon
   (`deliver`, `fly` and `[space]` are already present in the working tree).

No build, `verify`, browser, probe or gate command was run.

## Remaining real producer / director decisions

1. **`ux.contract-target-ceiling` blocks the contracted launch objective.**
   `tools/lib/guidanceTargets.mjs` currently permits `targetMode: none` only for
   `kind: travel | wait`. The signed intent requires `ch13:return:launch` to be
   a control-only `interact` with zero targets. This is the same narrow-gate
   class root is already fixing; it must be widened to admit a control-only
   `interact` with `maxVisibleTargets: 0`. The contract was **not** falsified to
   `wait` to evade it. This is the only mirrored gate failure.
2. **`production.mutationBoundary`** is set to `planning-only` to match the
   current lock. Advancing it to `bounded-runtime` is a lock/brief decision that
   root owns; the contract cannot grant itself the boundary.
3. **`allowedPaths` / `protectedPaths`** are carried through from the stale
   template and must be replaced wholesale from the updated brief and lock.
4. **`evidence.headedTaste.required: true`** and `realGpuRequired: true` are
   carried forward from the intent's hardware and listening obligations;
   confirm as a director decision.
5. **Shot-to-beat span.** `shot.cg.return` is declared on `ch13-return` but, per
   the accepted ledger, spans into `anc.cg.repeated-measure` and
   `anc.cg.demonstration-opened` because the ledger groups `ch13:survey:offer`
   into it. Confirm the grouping or split it into a tenth shot.
6. **Anchor naming not covered by the rename map.** `anc.cg.home-steady` carries
   the Score lane's `anc.cg.restored-entry` semantics, and the lane's
   `anc.cg.final-texture-release` is expressed as release prose on
   `sc.cg.independent-settled` and `anc.cg.handback` rather than as a new
   anchor, so no anchor was invented. Confirm, or commission the extra ids.
7. **Signatures.** `status` stays `draft` pending the three exact director
   signatures; `director-signoffs.json` is unchanged and no signature was
   fabricated.
